snippet.title: Galacard: Ackian Archives - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Galacard: Ackian Archives - now available on itch for all PC platforms - is a collection of slightly enhanced ports of games from Bipedal Studios' Galacard series. It includes the original Galacard as well as its sequels, Galacard Platinum and Galacard Advance. Check it out!
https://bipedal-studios.itch.io/galacard-ackian-archives
